name: Oz Comic-Con Adelaide
blurb: Adelaide's stop on the Oz Comic-Con circuit, with film, cosplay, comics and author guests at the Adelaide Showgrounds.

editions.evidence: City page countdown text: 'countdown to oz comic-con adelaide 2027! March 13 & 14, 2027 Adelaide Showgrounds'

notes: Same page structure as the other Oz Comic-Con cities: cards show a 'View Guest Bio' button with no name/credit text, so names came from each card's own profile-page link slug and known-for is blank throughout. Verify pass (2026-10-05): reversed to stale -- the guest photos are all uploaded to the site's 2026/02 and 2026/05 folders and independent search confirms Oz Comic-Con's most recent Adelaide show ran May 30-31, 2026 with Gordon Cormier as a headline guest (matching the 'Gordon-Cancellation-Adel.jpg' tile still on the page), so this is that already-concluded show's lineup and cancellations, not an announcement for March 13-14, 2027; cleared to none-yet.
